title: hotfix: fix SLO enforcer regional failover race and load-shedding mismatch
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Fix race condition in SLO enforcer during regional failover that could cause duplicate load-shedding and request throttling; improved hysteresis and metrics; added integration test and canary rollout.
description: Context: During a recent incident customers observed excessive load-shedding during regional failover where the SLO enforcer would apply shedding policies twice for the same flow. Root cause: an ordering/race between region-transition callbacks and the enforcer refresh loop could cause two overlapping apply operations and inconsistent hysteresis state. This PR introduces a minimal hotfix: add a region-transition mutex and idempotent apply path, normalize backoff hysteresis, and ensure metrics/tags indicate which transition path executed. Changes include a small refactor to make policy application idempotent, reconciliation to prefer existing higher-priority policies instead of replacing, and a short debounce window for transition events. Tests: unit + new integration test that simulates simultaneous regional failover and traffic spike; e2e canary deployment to staging-region passed. Rollout: squash-merged to main and promoted to prod via canary in us-west-2 then global. Linked tickets: ENG-1842 SRE-308 SUP-4123.
commits: fix: add region transition mutex and make apply idempotent (pri-shah)
refactor: normalize hysteresis/backoff logic and expose transition metric tags
test: add integration failover simulation and deterministic timing
chore: update chart values to lower initial shedding aggressiveness during rollout
review_comments: Ethan Briggs: Can we add a comment explaining why the mutex is coarse-grained? Author reply: Added comment and linked to design note; kept coarse lock to avoid complex ordering bugs.
Marta Lopez: Integration test looks flakey on first run, CI showed a timeout. Author reply: Increased deterministic timing and added retry in test harness; CI now stable.
Jon Kim: Suggest exposing a metric for transition latency to help on-call debugging. Author reply: Exposed slo_enforcer_region_transition_ms with tags for source/target region.
Ops (post-merge): Please watch slo_enforcer.load_shedding.count and slo_enforcer.region_transition_ms during the canary rollout.
Author: Canary rolled to us-west-2 at 2025-11-22T15:30Z; no regressions observed, promoted to prod with gradual bumping of shedding thresholds.
Reviewer: Approved and requested squash merge.
CI: green after rerun (one flaky integration retry).
ci_checks: integration tests: pass (1 retry due to timing flake)
notes_for_oncall: If regional failover triggers an unexpected spike in load-shedding, revert to previous chart values (charts/slo-enforcer/values.yaml) and open SUP-4123; observe slo_enforcer.region_transition_ms and slo_enforcer.load_shedding.applied_count.
changelog_entry: Hotfix: Prevent duplicate load-shedding during regional failover by making SLO enforcer apply idempotent and adding transition mutex; adds integration test and metrics.
